sql:
SELECT c.region,
       SUM(l.qty * l.unit_cents) - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_cents), 0) AS net_revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_lines l ON l.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.placed_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.placed_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY net_revenue_cents DESC
